intro.title: Institutional profile
intro.description1: Schobot is a company working in information and communications technology and in developing knowledge, educational, research and training solutions. Its vision is to use knowledge, specialist expertise and digital technology to offer products and services that help individuals and institutions learn, produce, collaborate and grow.
intro.description2: We are not a substitute for the person or the specialist. We build supportive tools and environments that strengthen their ability to reach knowledge, organize their work and improve productivity, while verification, evaluation and decision-making remain a human responsibility.
intro.description3: Our philosophy: people first, knowledge as the basis of progress, and technology as a tool for empowerment. We measure the value of solutions not by how new the technology is, but by their real benefit to the user, ease of use, quality of output, and respect for privacy and integrity.

mission.description: To develop integrated educational, academic, research and technical solutions that combine human expertise, digital innovation and responsible AI, empowering individuals and institutions to learn, produce and collaborate efficiently.

schobot.seoTitle: Schobot Platform for Researchers | AI in Scientific Research
schobot.title: Researchers Platform and App
schobot.intro: A digital environment for researchers, academics and research teams. It supports organizing the stages of research work, working with references and documents, collaboration and knowledge exchange, and using supporting AI tools. It turns hard-copy knowledge into searchable, citable electronic knowledge, while verification and scientific judgment stay with the researcher.

sections.title: Services and capabilities
items: Smart analysis of literature and references: reading documents and extracting topics, ideas and first summaries.
PDF and document processing: converting and extracting content so it is easier to review and edit, within the supported formats.
Multilingual support: working with material in several languages and translating between the languages the platform supports.
Organizing research work: planning projects and tasks and tracking progress.
Research teams and academic collaboration.
Methodological and statistical support, within the scope of service actually available.
Editing and language proofreading.
Training and consulting in research skills, academic writing and responsible use of AI.

partnerships.seoTitle: Schobot partnerships & services | Universities, institutions and schools
partnerships.title: Partnerships and services for universities, institutions and schools
partnerships.intro: We work with universities, research centres, government bodies, factories, schools, nurseries and publishers. Pick what suits you, or start with a combined partnership that covers every area. We believe in partnerships built on clear goals, complementary expertise and shared value.

sections.title: Partnership paths
rows: A training initiative for researchers on the Schobot platform, support preparing research for publication, updating university textbooks and building joint research teams, smart university management systems.
Digitising and indexing heritage and manuscripts with OCR, digital archives, administration automation with an AI agent.
Predictive models for productivity and failures, agricultural, industrial and environmental studies and consulting, AI agents and automation.
Children's programmes in coding, AI, robotics, thinking and leadership, tech and summer camps, educational games.
A business incubator for scientists' and researchers' ideas with profit sharing, the annual BAZ Academy Ambassador licence, authoring, publishing and children's content production.

sections.title: Consulting and studies
sections.text: Teams of scientists and researchers in history, religion, science, medicine, agriculture, technology, engineering, education, psychology, management, accounting, statistics and programming. Example work: historical, religious, environmental and chemical studies, economic and investment studies and feasibility studies, research, statistical and educational consulting.

sections.title: Software solutions and predictive AI
items: Agriculture: forecasting crop productivity and improving seed selection.
Industry: predicting failures and improving operations.
Institutions: language models, AI agents, automation, apps, websites and university management systems, and a language model available through an API.

sections.title: International publishing
sections.text: Research teams from varied disciplines help prepare papers under supervision and review, aiming for publication in peer-reviewed journals. The package covers statistical analysis, translation, language editing, plagiarism checks, journal submission and following up on reviewer comments.

sections.title: OCR and digital publishing
sections.text: Get more from your documents: scanned Arabic and English documents become fully editable, searchable text files using the precise RDI engine, alongside publishing and digital publishing for books, research and scientific content.

sections.title: University training initiative
sections.text: An initiative that trains a university's researchers on Schobot at no cost to the university. It targets four problems: delayed thesis defences, weak graduation projects, research that isn't ready for international publication, and the difficulty of updating university textbooks.
items: What we offer: 4 practical training sessions within a week on Zoom, recorded for attendees, to train 10,000 faculty members and researchers, with a free tool package during the training and for 30 days after.
What we ask of partner universities: announce the partnership, enrol students and faculty, and publish the trainee survey results.
faq: Does the programme replace the researcher?
No. It prepares a first draft; the researcher writes the study and is responsible for it.
There is no cost to the university for the training.
The training certificate is optional and carries a fee. Contact us for details.

sections.title: Optional packages for university members (after a 50% discount)
BAZ Academy Ambassador
sections.text: An annual licence to deliver BAZ Academy training programmes in several countries, with ready-made content and support teams.

sections.title: Future projects
sections.text: Coming soon: educational games whose content is written by scientists and researchers and built by Schobot developers.

initiative.seoTitle: Schobot's free initiative to train 10,000 researchers
initiative.title: Schobot's free initiative to train 10,000 faculty members and researchers
initiative.intro: Hands-on training on Schobot, the AI research tool, plus academic writing and preparing for international publication. 10,000 seats, first come first served. The training, all its materials and the tool package are completely free, with no upfront payment or card details.

sections.title: Why this initiative
sections.text: For 6 years Schobot has been building an AI tool for scientific research from Cairo. 84,000 users from 100 countries have used it, we have worked with 190 universities and educational institutions, and 200,000 researchers in 20 countries have trained with us since 2021 through free and paid training and events, with a team from 12 countries. (According to Schobot data)

sections.title: Problems it targets
items: Weak student performance in graduation projects and difficulty with research.
Master's and PhD students falling behind on their research and defences.
The difficulty of updating a university textbook with the latest studies in several languages.
The difficulty of preparing research that can be published in international journals.

sections.title: Four tracks
sections.text: Choose one track when you register.
rows: Literature analysis, finding research gaps, a documented first draft of a graduation project, gathering information from studies in different languages.
Advanced literature analysis, enriching theses with studies in 5 languages, building methodology and measures and discussing results.
A practical exercise updating a full chapter of a university textbook with multilingual studies.
Preparing articles and reviews, finding publishable gaps, using studies in other languages to support the thesis.

sections.title: How the training is structured
sections.text: 4 sessions within a week, each 1.5 to 2 hours, on Zoom and recorded for attendees: two training sessions (theory and guided practice) and two self-directed practice sessions on your own research, supervised by specialists.

sections.title: What participants get
items: New research gaps ready to write about.
A practical plan for their thesis, paper or university textbook.
A multilingual reference list they extract themselves with the tool.
Academic writing training.
A free tool package during the training and for 30 days after.
A digital training kit (files, examples and short videos).
Follow-up from specialist supervisors and a small research team to build an academic network.

sections.title: Language, certificate and privacy
items: Language: mainly Arabic, with materials in English and French, and full training in English or French for groups that ask.
Certificate: an optional attendance certificate for an administrative fee; not required to take part.
Privacy: participants' data and research are protected under the approved privacy policy; WhatsApp group links are sent to the registered email.

sections.title: Who can take part
items: Seriousness, commitment and hands-on practice.
A normal internet connection and a suitable device (a laptop is preferred).
No prior knowledge of the tool is needed.
Choose one track when you register.

sections.title: After the initiative
sections.text: For those who complete it (attending the practical sessions and finishing the tasks): joining the research teams initiative and the in-person Schobot conference in Cairo.

sections.title: Frequently asked questions
faq: Yes. Only the certificate is optional and carries a fee.
Does the tool write my research?
No. It helps with research and prepares a documented first draft; reviewing it is the researcher's responsibility.
The WhatsApp group link for your track is sent to your email, and dates are announced there.
Can the training be in English or French?
Yes, for groups that ask for it.
